items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: But Molo on drums, Hal Morento on piano, myself on trumpet, Raymond on clarinet, Philly Mill on bass.

ctx.x: And I think Sam or something. Sam was the brother, I was the drummer. Sam was the drummer, I never met him.

I played with him too, with Hal Morento. You know Hal, the piano player? Well I played, we were supposed to cut the peculiar rag on a record with that group. But Molo on drums, Hal Morento on piano, myself on trumpet, Raymond on clarinet, Philly Mill on bass. I forget who the other one fellow was, but we rehearsed at Hal's Barbershop. Hal was cutting there then, to cut the peculiar rag and the dirty rag, I believe it was in the cut, cut a record, two sides. And we never, I don't know what happened, we didn't cut…
